summary: Phase 149O.1H.1R -- HATP Repair Phase Evidence-Coherence / Canonical Report Trust Repair: narrow, documentation-only investigation of why 149O.1H.1's canonical phase-completion report is incomplete with missing trust field internal_evidence_coherence. Independently re-derived, from source/history/tests rather than trusting 149O.1H.1's own summary, every checkable technical claim: fresh reruns of the 93-test repair suite, the 100-test Wave-3 core regression, and the 166-test independent-verification suite all matched claimed counts exactly; the pre-repair .0001Z/.0009Z timestamp collision was independently reproduced by reconstructing the module from commit d75b96b1~1 and calling parse_hatp_proof directly, and confirmed closed (both now raise InvalidProofSchemaError) on current source, with millisecond-precision timestamps still accepted; the boolean proof_version trap was confirmed rejected via a fresh UnsupportedProofVersionError probe against current source; the shared _require_* validator layer was confirmed, by direct source read, to be invoked from parse_hatp_proof and from HumanApprovalProvenanceProof/Ag3OperationReference/Ag5OperationReference's __post_init__ methods; AG3/AG5 golden digests were independently recomputed directly from test_hatp_canonical_serialization.py's own fixture constants and matched 149O.1H.1's reported values exactly; the production diff was confirmed as exactly one file (human_approval_trusted_provenance.py) with docs/contracts/ empty; task-lifecycle metadata (tasks/done/20260806-1624-phase-149o-1h-1-...) confirmed commit d75b96b1's file list matches its own Allowed Files list exactly, establishing phase ownership independent of git chronology; and the 8 modified historical-verification-suite tests were audited and found to preserve, not destroy, the original finding record -- each retains an expanded docstring explicitly stating the pre-repair behavior before describing the post-repair assertion, none were deleted, the suite's 166-test total is unchanged, and the original .0001Z/.0009Z collision remains independently reconstructable from git history (as demonstrated by this phase's own reproduction from d75b96b1~1). Conclusion: 149O.1H.1's technical repair evidence is internally coherent. The report artifact's own automated trust gate is not: reading validate_internal_report_coherence() in src/pcae/core/phase_reports.py (read-only; not modified) revealed its phase-ID-token regex '(?<![A-Za-z0-9])\d+[A-Za-z]+(?:\.?\d+[A-Za-z]*)?(?![A-Za-z0-9])' contains only a single optional dot-extension, so it can only ever extract two-component phase IDs (e.g. '149O.1H') and can never extract a three-component ID's full form (e.g. '149O.1H.1') -- empirically confirmed by running the pattern against sample report prose. Because 149O.1H.1's evidence text legitimately cites related same-series finding/phase identifiers (B-149O.1H-1, B-149O.1H-2, 149O.1G, 149O.1F, 149O.1F.2, 149O.1C) inline -- which is exactly what a repair phase's evidence should do -- the checker's same_series filter (correctly, on its own terms) finds non-empty overlap and flags 'test evidence is linked only to other phase identities'. Directly simulating the checker against both promoted report generations in .pcae/phase-reports/ confirmed the precedent phase 149O.1F.1 evaded this only because its terser test_results prose happened not to cite any same-series token (same_series=[]), not because of any real difference in evidence quality -- 149O.1F.1 is not proof the check is reliable, only proof it is fragile. The one documented governed suppression mechanism (report.metadata['test_evidence_classification'] == 'inherited_regression', per the Phase 134E.9 code comment) is correctly set to that value in .pcae/phase-completion-metadata.json as of commit a3215148, but pcae phase-report create -- the actual command that builds the PhaseReport object the validator inspects -- has no CLI argument to carry it into report.metadata (confirmed: src/pcae/commands/phase_reports.py's create handler only ever writes commit_attribution, phase_id, and source_revision into report.metadata; src/pcae/cli.py's pr_create_parser exposes no matching flag), so the value is inert with respect to the actual trust gate. No workaround that would omit, reword, or truncate genuine evidence citations to dodge the regex was attempted -- that would constitute fabricating matching data. Two independent, source-confirmed report-generation defects (tokenizer regex; unwired CLI-to-metadata plumbing for the one documented suppression field) are therefore recorded as Blocking report-trust findings, and a bounded future report-trust/validator repair phase is recommended rather than hidden inside this phase's scope, per the governing prompt's explicit prohibition on modifying trust-gate production code in this phase. Zero production files were modified: git diff --name-only against the 149O.1H.1 commit range confirms zero files under src/pcae/ touched by this phase; this phase's own changes are limited to this documentation file, PROJECT_STATUS.md, CHANGELOG.md, and task-lifecycle bookkeeping. Fast Green re-run: 4531 passed, identical to the entering baseline, no regression. Final trust verdict: 149O.1H.1 CANONICAL COMPLETION TRUST NOT REPAIRED -- INTERNAL EVIDENCE COHERENCE REMAINS BLOCKING. Technical status (supported by this phase's fresh, independent evidence): B-149O.1H-1 CLOSED BY IMPLEMENTATION, PENDING INDEPENDENT 149O.1H.2 RE-VERIFICATION; B-149O.1H-2 CLOSED BY IMPLEMENTATION, PENDING INDEPENDENT 149O.1H.2 RE-VERIFICATION. HATP production remains NOT READY. B-149O-1 through B-149O-4 remain OPEN, unaffected. F-149O.1C-2 remains editorial debt only. F-149O.1C-1 remains independently confirmed implemented. B-149O.1F-1 remains confirmed closed. Recommended next phase: a bounded report-trust/validator repair (not yet numbered/authorized) fixing the tokenizer regex and wiring the classification field through pcae phase-report create; 149O.1H.2 must not begin under the claim that 149O.1H.1 is trusted-complete until that repair lands and 149O.1H.1's canonical report is regenerated and shows internal_evidence_coherence present. See docs/PHASE_149O_1H_1R_HATP_REPAIR_EVIDENCE_COHERENCE_CANONICAL_REPORT_TRUST_REPAIR.md.
